//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Configurable Despawn Timer -> Config

globalItemDespawnTimeInTicks.//: The delay in ticks when an item should despawn. Minecraft's default time is 6000 ticks. 1 second is 20 ticks. min: 1, max: 2,147,483,647

globalExperienceOrbDespawnTimeInTicks.//: The delay in ticks when experience orbs should despawn. Minecraft's default time is 6000 ticks. 1 second is 20 ticks. min: 1, max: 2,147,483,647

preventDespawnForPlayerItems.//: Whether items thrown/dropped by players should not despawn at all. Works for manual dropping and also on death. Overrides the other time settings.
